628:     /**
629:      * Brings the agent chat back after the app was closed: the tabs that were
630:      * open and the active session, with history and todos. First launch (no
631:      * saved UI state) continues the most recent session, like `opencode -c`.
632:      * If the user closed all tabs on purpose, the chat starts empty.
633:      */
634:     private fun restoreAgentUi() {
635:         val existing = sessions.list().associateBy { it.id }
636:         val ui = AgentSettings.readUiState(getApplication())
637:         when {
638:             ui != null && ui.openTabs.isNotEmpty() -> {
639:                 _openTabs.value = ui.openTabs.mapNotNull { existing[it] }
640:                 val activeId = ui.lastSessionId?.takeIf { existing.containsKey(it) }
641:                     ?: _openTabs.value.firstOrNull()?.id
642:                 if (activeId != null) showSession(activeId)
643:             }
644:             ui == null -> {
645:                 // nothing saved yet (first run after update): continue latest
646:                 sessions.list().firstOrNull()?.let { latest ->
647:                     _openTabs.value = listOf(latest)
648:                     showSession(latest.id)
649:                 }
650:             }
651:             else -> Unit // the user closed all tabs — keep the chat empty
652:         }
653:     }
654: 
655:     fun refreshProjects() {
656:         _projects.value = workspace.projects
657:             .listFiles { file -> file.isDirectory }
658:             .orEmpty()
659:             .map { Project(it.name, it) }
660:             .sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() }
661:     }
662: 
663:     fun createProject(rawName: String) {
664:         val name = rawName.trim()
665:         if (name.isEmpty()) return
666:         val dir = workspace.projectDir(name)
667:         val main = File(dir, "main.py")
668:         if (!main.isFile) main.writeText(DEFAULT_SCRIPT, Charsets.UTF_8)
669:         refreshProjects()
670:         _projects.value.firstOrNull { it.dir == dir }?.let { select(it) }
671:     }
672: 
673:     fun deleteProject(project: Project) {
674:         project.dir.deleteRecursively()
675:         if (_selected.value?.dir == project.dir) {
676:             _selected.value = null
677:             _script.value = ""
678:         }
679:         refreshProjects()
680:     }
681: 
682:     fun select(project: Project) {
683:         _selected.value = project
684:         loadScriptForMode()
685:     }
686: 
687:     fun setEditorMode(mode: RuntimeKind) {
688:         editorMode.value = mode
689:         if (_selected.value != null) loadScriptForMode()
690:     }
691: 
692:     private fun loadScriptForMode() {
693:         val project = _selected.value ?: return
694:         when (editorMode.value) {
695:             RuntimeKind.NODE -> {
696:                 val jsFile = File(project.dir, "main.js")
697:                 _script.value = jsFile.takeIf { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) ?: DEFAULT_JS_SCRIPT
698:             }
699:             else -> {
700:                 _script.value = File(project.dir, "main.py")
701:                     .takeIf { it.isFile }
702:                     ?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
703:                     ?: DEFAULT_SCRIPT
704:             }
705:         }
706:     }
707: 
708:     /** Saves the editor content under the active mode's file name. */
709:     fun saveScript(text: String) {
710:         val project = _selected.value ?: return
711:         when (editorMode.value) {
712:             RuntimeKind.NODE -> File(project.dir, "main.js").writeText(text, Charsets.UTF_8)
713:             else -> File(project.dir, "main.py").writeText(text, Charsets.UTF_8)
714:         }
715:     }
716: 
717:     fun runtimeAvailable(): Boolean = when (editorMode.value) {
718:         RuntimeKind.NODE, RuntimeKind.NPX -> true
719:         else -> PythonRuntime.isAvailable()
720:     }
721: 
722:     fun runtimeVersion(): String? = when (editorMode.value) {
723:         RuntimeKind.NODE, RuntimeKind.NPX -> JsRuntime.VERSION
724:         else -> PythonRuntime.version()
725:     }
726: 
727:     fun runScript(text: String) {
728:         val project = _selected.value ?: return
729:         if (_runState.value is RunState.Running) return
730:         when (editorMode.value) {
731:             RuntimeKind.NODE -> {
732:                 saveScript(text)
733:                 _output.value = emptyList()
734:                 _runState.value = RunState.Running
735:                 handle = jsRuntime.execute(
736:                     ExecRequest(
737:                         kind = RuntimeKind.NODE,
738:                         target = File(project.dir, "main.js").absolutePath,
739:                         args = emptyList(),
740:                         cwd = project.dir,
741:                     ),
742:                     runListener,
743:                 )
744:             }
745:             RuntimeKind.PYTHON -> {
746:                 if (!PythonRuntime.isAvailable()) {
747:                     _runState.value = RunState.Failed("Python ещё запускается — попробуйте через пару секунд")
748:                     return
749:                 }
750:                 saveScript(text)
751:                 _output.value = emptyList()
752:                 _runState.value = RunState.Running
753:                 handle = PythonRuntime.execute(
754:                     ExecRequest(
755:                         kind = RuntimeKind.PYTHON,
756:                         target = File(project.dir, "main.py").absolutePath,
757:                         args = emptyList(),
758:                         cwd = project.dir,
759:                     ),
760:                     runListener,
761:                 )
762:             }
763:             RuntimeKind.NPX -> {
764:                 // The npx tab runs through runNpxCommand with its own command line.
765:             }
766:         }
767:     }
768: 
769:     fun runNpxCommand(line: String) {
770:         if (_runState.value is RunState.Running) return
771:         val parsed = NpxRuntime.parseCommandLine(line)
772:         if (parsed == null) {
773:             _runState.value = RunState.Failed("Не удалось разобрать команду — ожидается «пакет[@версия] [аргументы]»")
774:             return
775:         }
776:         val (spec, args) = parsed
777:         _output.value = emptyList()
778:         _runState.value = RunState.Running
779:         handle = npxRuntime.execute(
780:             ExecRequest(
781:                 kind = RuntimeKind.NPX,
782:                 target = spec.name + (spec.version?.let { "@$it" } ?: ""),
783:                 args = args,
784:                 cwd = _selected.value?.dir ?: workspace.root,
785:             ),
786:             runListener,
787:         )
788:     }
789: 
790:     /**
791:      * Cancellation is cooperative: the interpreter finishes the current script
792:      * and the run is reported with exit code 130.
793:      */
794:     fun cancelRun() {
795:         handle?.cancel()
796:     }
797: 
798:     fun clearOutput() {
799:         _output.value = emptyList()
800:         _runState.value = RunState.Idle
801:     }
802: 
803:     fun activate(rawKey: String): Boolean = licenseManager.activate(rawKey)
804: 
805:     fun forgetLicense() = licenseManager.forget()

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 12
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 60

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

329:         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
330:             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
331:         }
332:         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
333:         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
334:         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
335:     }

337:     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
338:         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
339:         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
340:         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
341:         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
342:         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
343:         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
344:         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
345:     }
346: 
347:     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
348:         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
349:         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
350:         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
351:         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
352:         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
353:             if (f.isFile) {
354:                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
355:                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
356:             }
357:         }
358:         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
359:         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
360:             .take(200)
361:             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
362:     }

364:     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {

514:     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {

521:                     '?' -> append('.')
522:                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)

524:                 i++

527:         }

432: /**
433:  * The agent is blocked on clarifying questions. The submit button is a
434:  * full-width filled Button that is ALWAYS enabled; a single multiple-choice
435:  * question submits instantly on tap.
436:  */
437: @Composable
438: private fun QuestionCard(pq: AppViewModel.PendingQuestion) {
439:     val answers = remember(pq) { mutableStateOf(List(pq.questions.size) { "" }) }
440:     val instantSubmit = pq.questions.size == 1 && pq.questions.first().options.isNotEmpty()
441: 
442:     fun submit() {
443:         val text = if (pq.questions.size == 1) {
444:             answers.value[0].ifBlank { "(нет ответа)" }
445:         } else {
446:             pq.questions.mapIndexed { i, q -> "${i + 1}. ${q.question.take(60)} → ${answers.value[i].ifBlank { "(нет ответа)" }}" }
447:                 .joinToString("\n")
448:         }
449:         pq.answer(text)
450:     }
451: 
452:     Surface(
453:         color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.tertiaryContainer,
454:         shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
455:         modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
456:     ) {
457:         Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
458:             Text(
459:                 "🤖 Агент ждёт вашего ответа",
460:                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
461:                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onTertiaryContainer,
462:             )
463:             Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
464:             // Bounded, scrollable question area — the submit button always
465:             // stays visible below it, even with the keyboard open.
466:             Column(
467:                 modifier = Modifier
468:                     .heightIn(max = 260.dp)
469:                     .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
470:                 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
471:             ) {
472:                 pq.questions.forEachIndexed { qi, question ->
473:                     Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
474:                         question.header?.let {
475:                             Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onTertiaryContainer)
476:                         }
477:                         Text(question.question, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
478:                         if (question.options.isNotEmpty()) {
479:                             Text(
480:                                 if (instantSubmit) "Нажмите вариант — ответ уйдёт сразу:" else "Выберите вариант:",
481:                                 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
482:                                 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
483:                             )
484:                             question.options.forEach { option ->
485:                                 val selected = answers.value[qi] == option
486:                                 Surface(
487:                                     color = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
488:                                     shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
489:                                     border = if (selected) BorderStroke(2.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary) else null,
490:                                     modifier = Modifier
491:                                         .fillMaxWidth()
492:                                         .padding(vertical = 2.dp)
493:                                         .clickable {
494:                                             answers.value = answers.value.toMutableList().also { it[qi] = option }
495:                                             if (instantSubmit) pq.answer(option)
496:                                         },
497:                                 ) {
498:                                     Row(Modifier.padding(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
499:                                         Text(
500:                                             if (selected) "◉" else "○",
501:                                             color = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
502:                                         )
503:                                         Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
504:                                         Text(
505:                                             option,
506:                                             style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
507:                                             color = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
508:                                         )
509:                                     }
510:                                 }
511:                             }
512:                         } else {
513:                             OutlinedTextField(
514:                                 value = answers.value[qi],
515:                                 onValueChange = { text -> answers.value = answers.value.toMutableList().also { it[qi] = text } },
516:                                 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
517:                                 placeholder = { Text("ваш ответ…") },
518:                                 singleLine = true,
519:                             )
520:                         }
521:                     }
522:                 }
523:             }
524:             Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
525:             Button(
526:                 onClick = { submit() },
527:                 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
528:             ) { Text(if (instantSubmit) "Ответить своим текстом" else "Ответить агенту") }
529:         }
530:     }
531: }

Now I have a good picture. Let me also check MiniShell.kt, Sessions.kt, and the CI workflow, plus tests. Let me also check git/CI to see if the build can run locally (gradle). The user said "потом пуш и комит и сборка там же" — "then push and commit and build there too" — likely they mean I should push, commit, and build (via CI/GitHub Actions) at the end. The MANIFEST says builds are in GitHub Actions, and $GH_TOKEN is available.

So the deliverables:
1. Fix bugs/incompleteness:
   - Increase max rounds (default 12 → higher, limit 60 → much higher, e.g. 500? but the UI takes 2 digits). Let's raise MAX_STEPS_LIMIT to e.g. 300 and allow 3 digits in UI.
   - Handle 900s request timeout: add retry on network timeout, and importantly, make long requests not fail. Also the "generation" step: models can be slow; maybe switch to streaming to avoid gateway timeouts. Hmm, implementing SSE streaming in LlmClient would fix "время истекает на запрос 900 с" (time expires on request at 900s) — this is likely the Zen gateway or a proxy timing out because the connection is idle while the model generates. Actually, the readTimeout is 300s; but the user says 900s expires — that means somewhere the timeout is 900 s. Hmm, maybe a reverse proxy between. Actually possibly the issue: HttpURLConnection readTimeout of 300s. If a request takes longer, "Read timed out" after 300s. The user says 900s... maybe Zen's gateway gives up at 900 s (15 min) and returns an error, or the mobile network drops.

The robust fix: implement streaming (SSE) chat completions so the connection keeps sending data during generation, plus retry logic. Streaming is a significant but valuable change. It also gives progressive UI updates. But it complicates the tool call aggregation (delta-based). Many OpenAI-compatible servers support stream + tools, though some struggle. Safer: keep non-streaming as the default but add:
- configurable read timeout (longer, e.g. 900s+) with periodic keep-alive? Not possible with HttpURLConnection non-streaming.
- retry on timeout with backoff, and continue the loop rather than aborting the whole turn.

Let me think about what best addresses the user complaint with reasonable risk:

"раундов слишком мало" → raise limits substantially: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS 12 → e.g. 40; MAX_STEPS_LIMIT 60 → 500; UI take(3) digits. Also make rounds count = tool calls, and the loop should not fail the whole turn when the step budget is hit — instead, if the budget is exhausted but the model was mid-work, continue? Hmm. Better: when limit reached, add an automatic "continue" nudge? Real opencode has maxSteps with a warning. A nicer approach: on hitting the budget, synthesize a user message "Continue where you left off..." and continue up to a hard cap? That could loop forever. Simpler and predictable: raise limits, and on budget exhaustion, tell the user that they can continue ("напишите «продолжай»"), and add a `/continue` command? Hmm, but history persists so simply sending a new message continues.

"иногда время истекает на запрос 900 с когда аи очень многое делает особенно генерация и ожидание чего либо" → the LLM request itself times out when the model does a lot. Fix: streaming (SSE) to avoid idle-timeout, and retry. I think streaming is the right call: it's the actual root cause of idle connection timeouts, and it lets us show "думает…" in the UI. But it's a big change with tool-call delta aggregation.

Alternative pragmatic fix that keeps non-streaming: 
- Increase readTimeout to e.g. 1_200_000 (20 min) and add `setFixedLengthStreamingMode`? no.
- Add retry: on SocketTimeoutException, retry up to 2 times. But if the server takes 900s to answer and the same request is repeated, we may get the same result... it's not idempotent for tool calls, but a retry is generally the pragmatic approach.

Hmm. Let me consider: the user explicitly says "иногда время истекает на запрос 900 с" — so the request fails after 900 s. With readTimeout=300s, the failure would be at 300s. So maybe... the failing part is not the LLM chat call but a tool: bash timeout (120s), webfetch (30s), GitHub (60/120s). Hmm, 900 s though. `latch.await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)` = 600 s. Not 900.

Wait — maybe the real number: since the readTimeout of 300s applies per-read, the connection can be alive as long as data trickles. Hmm.

Let me search for "900" in the repo.

Also "потом пуш и комит и сборка там же" — "then push and commit and build there too" — "там же" = "there too", i.e. in the same place — GitHub Actions runner. So they want the github tool to support pushing/committing and building in the Actions runner. Maybe they want a `run_wait` op: wait for a workflow run to finish (poll until completed, with timeout) — currently the agent has to poll repeatedly, burning rounds. That's a real недоработка: "ожидание чего либо" (waiting for something) — the agent has to poll `runs` repeatedly, which burns rounds and each poll is a round. So implementing a blocking `runs_wait`/`wait` op with a timeout (e.g. up to 15 min) would be a big win: fewer rounds, no timeouts.

So the plan:
1. `AgentSettings`: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS 12 → 40 (or 30), MAX_STEPS_LIMIT 60 → 500, UI take(3). Test update.
2. `LlmClient`: 
   - streaming support (SSE) with fallback? 
   - longer timeouts, retry with backoff on timeouts/5xx, honor cancellation.
   Let me think about a clean design: add `fun chat(messages, tools, onDelta: ((String)->Unit)?): Response`. If onDelta == null → non-streaming. Agent passes a delta callback to emit "thinking" events? That adds UI complexity but is nice. Hmm — maybe simpler: keep non-streaming default, but add retry and larger timeout, plus a heartbeat. Honestly, streaming is the "right" fix and opencode itself streams. But risk: some models via Zen stream tool calls fine (OpenAI-compatible). Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI all support streaming with tools. Local llama.cpp/vLLM servers also support stream.

Given the user's complaint about timeouts during long generations, I'll implement streaming with a safe fallback: if the response Content-Type isn't SSE or parsing fails before any content, fall back to non-streaming. That's robust.

3. `GitHubClient`: add `run_wait` (block until run completes, polling every 15 s, timeout configurable up to ~20 min), plus `push_files` improvements? Also "коммит" — the contents API pushes one commit per file which is slow and creates many commits; better: add `push` support for multiple files in one commit via the git data API (create blobs/tree/commit/ref update) — that's a "недоработка" and reduces rounds. Hmm, that's more work but valuable: `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/git/blobs`, `/git/trees`, `/git/commits`, `/git/refs`. It also makes atomic commits. That's a nice improvement and matches "пуш и комит".

Let me check what tests exist and if the build can run. Also check .github/workflows/android.yml.

Let me also verify whether gradle build works locally (probably no Android SDK). MANIFEST says CI only. And the user wants "сборка там же" (build in CI). So after changes: commit + push + watch CI.

Let me look at the remaining relevant files.

name: Android

on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
    tags: ["v*"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The build derives versionCode/versionName from the nearest tag; the
          # default checkout of a ref does not fetch tags even at depth 0.
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      # Chaquopy needs a build machine Python matching the app's major.minor
      # version to precompile .pyc; ubuntu-24.04's default is 3.12.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Cache Chaquopy downloads
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.chaquopy
            ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2
          key: chaquopy-${{ hashFiles('android/app/build.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: chaquopy-

      - name: Unit tests
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testDebugUnitTest

      - name: Assemble debug APK
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug

      - name: Assemble release APK
        env:
          KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        # No working-directory here on purpose: this step works from the repo
        # root so the keystore lands in android/ (the Gradle rootProject) and
        # gradlew is invoked from android/.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${KEYSTORE_B64:-}" ]; then
            echo "No keystore secret configured; skipping signed release build."
            echo "Debug APK from the previous step is the only artifact."
            exit 0
          fi
          printf '%s' "$KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 -d > android/keystore.jks
          cat > android/keystore.properties <<EOF
          storeFile=keystore.jks
          storePassword=$KEYSTORE_PASS
          keyAlias=$KEY_ALIAS
          keyPassword=$KEY_PASS
          EOF
          cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleRelease

      - name: Upload APKs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pocketrun-apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
            android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

  keygen:
    name: Keygen self-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: tools/keygen

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - run: ./gradlew --no-daemon test

14: /**

17:  * `|` pipes and `>` / `>>` redirection for the built-in commands, plus
18:  * `python`, `node` and `npx` routed to the real app runtimes.

22:  */
23: class MiniShell(

25:     private val jsRuntime: JsRuntime,

28: 
29:     companion object {

34:             "ls", "mkdir", "mv", "node", "npm", "npx", "pwd", "python", "rm", "sleep", "tail",
35:             "touch", "true", "uname", "wc", "which", "help",

45:             Поддерживаются кавычки, && , | и > >> для встроенных команд.
46:         """.trimIndent()
47:     }
48: 
49:     data class Result(val exitCode: Int, val output: String) {
50:         val ok: Boolean get() = exitCode == 0
51:     }
52: 
53:     /** Executes [commandLine] with [cwd] as the working directory. */
54:     fun execute(commandLine: String, cwd: File, timeoutMs: Long = 120_000): Result {
55:         var dir = if (cwd.isDirectory) cwd else workspace.root
56:         val segments = splitAnd(commandLine)
57:         if (segments.isEmpty()) return Result(0, "")
58:         val out = StringBuilder()
59:         var lastExit = 0
60:         for (segment in segments) {
61:             if (lastExit != 0) break
62:             val r = runPipeline(segment, dir, timeoutMs) { d -> dir = d }
63:             out.append(r.output)
64:             lastExit = r.exitCode
65:         }
66:         return Result(lastExit, cap(out.toString()))
67:     }

69:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- structure

71:     /** Splits on && at top level (outside quotes). */
72:     private fun splitAnd(line: String): List<String> {
73:         val parts = mutableListOf<String>()
74:         val cur = StringBuilder()
75:         var quote: Char? = null
76:         var i = 0
77:         while (i < line.length) {
78:             val c = line[i]
79:             when {
80:                 quote != null -> {
81:                     cur.append(c)
82:                     if (c == quote) quote = null
83:                 }
84:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; cur.append(c) }
85:                 c == '&' && i + 1 < line.length && line[i + 1] == '&' -> {
86:                     if (cur.isNotBlank()) parts += cur.toString().trim()
87:                     cur.clear()
88:                     i++
89:                 }
90:                 else -> cur.append(c)
91:             }
92:             i++
93:         }
94:         if (cur.isNotBlank()) parts += cur.toString().trim()
95:         return parts
96:     }
97: 
98:     /** Runs one `cmd | cmd | cmd [> file]` pipeline segment. */
99:     private fun runPipeline(
100:         segment: String,
101:         dir: File,
102:         timeoutMs: Long,
103:         onCd: (File) -> Unit,
104:     ): Result {
105:         // split on top-level |
106:         val stages = mutableListOf<String>()
107:         val cur = StringBuilder()
108:         var quote: Char? = null
109:         var i = 0
110:         while (i < segment.length) {
111:             val c = segment[i]
112:             when {
113:                 quote != null -> { cur.append(c); if (c == quote) quote = null }
114:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; cur.append(c) }
115:                 c == '|' -> { stages += cur.toString().trim(); cur.clear() }
116:                 else -> cur.append(c)
117:             }
118:             i++
119:         }
120:         if (cur.isNotBlank()) stages += cur.toString().trim()
121:         if (stages.isEmpty()) return Result(0, "")
122: 
123:         var input = ""
124:         var exit = 0
125:         var redirectFile: File? = null
126:         var append = false
127: 
128:         for ((index, stage) in stages.withIndex()) {
129:             val (tokens, redir, redirAppend) = extractRedirect(tokenize(stage), dir)
130:             redirectFile = redir
131:             append = redirAppend
132:             if (tokens.isEmpty()) continue
133:             val cmd = tokens[0]
134:             val args = tokens.drop(1)
135: 
136:             // runtime commands ignore stdin/pipes — they run to completion
137:             val r = when (cmd) {
138:                 "python", "python3" -> runPython(args, dir, timeoutMs)
139:                 "node" -> runNode(args, dir, timeoutMs)
140:                 "npx" -> runNpx(args, dir, timeoutMs)
141:             "npm" -> npm(args, dir, timeoutMs)
142:                 else -> runBuiltin(cmd, args, dir, input, onCd)
143:             }
144:             exit = r.exitCode
145:             input = r.output
146:             // redirect only applies to the last stage
147:             if (index == stages.lastIndex) {
148:                 if (redirectFile != null) {
149:                     writeToFile(redirectFile, input, append)
150:                     return Result(r.exitCode, "")
151:                 }
152:             }
153:         }
154:         return Result(exit, input)
155:     }
156: 
157:     /** `> file` / `>> file` on built-in commands. */
158:     private fun extractRedirect(tokens: List<String>, dir: File): Triple<List<String>, File?, Boolean> {
159:         val gt = tokens.indexOfFirst { it == ">" || it == ">>" }
160:         if (gt < 0 || gt + 1 >= tokens.size) return Triple(tokens, null, false)
161:         val file = sandboxPath(tokens[gt + 1], dir)
162:         return Triple(tokens.subList(0, gt), file, tokens[gt] == ">>")
163:     }

165:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- builtins

167:     private fun runBuiltin(cmd: String, args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String, onCd: (File) -> Unit): Result {
168:         return when (cmd) {
169:             "pwd" -> Result(0, dir.relativeToOrNull(workspace.root)?.let { "./$it" } ?: dir.absolutePath + "\n")
170:             "cd" -> {
171:                 val target = sandboxPath(args.firstOrNull() ?: ".", dir)
172:                 if (target == null || !target.isDirectory) Result(1, "cd: ${args.firstOrNull() ?: ""}: нет такого каталога\n")

174:             }
175:             "ls" -> ls(args, dir)
176:             "cat" -> cat(args, dir, stdin)
177:             "echo" -> Result(0, args.joinToString(" ") + "\n")
178:             "mkdir" -> mkdir(args, dir)
179:             "rm" -> rm(args, dir)
180:             "mv" -> mv(args, dir)
181:             "cp" -> cp(args, dir)
182:             "touch" -> {
183:                 var ok = 0
184:                 for (a in flagsFree(args)) {

188:                 }
189:                 Result(ok, "")
190:             }
191:             "head" -> headTail(args, dir, fromStart = true)
192:             "tail" -> headTail(args, dir, fromStart = false)
193:             "wc" -> wc(args, dir, stdin)
194:             "find" -> find(args, dir)
195:             "grep" -> shellGrep(args, dir, stdin)
196:             "env" -> Result(0, "HOME=${workspace.root.absolutePath}\nLANG=C.UTF-8\n")
197:             "date" -> Result(0, SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss yyyy", Locale.US).format(Date()) + "\n")
198:             "sleep" -> {
199:                 val sec = args.firstOrNull()?.toFloatOrNull() ?: return Result(1, "sleep: нужен аргумент в секундах\n")
200:                 if (sec > 30f) return Result(1, "sleep: максимум 30 секунд\n")
201:                 Thread.sleep((sec * 1000).toLong())
202:                 Result(0, "")
203:             }
204:             "uname" -> Result(0, "Linux aarch64 PocketRun\n")
205:             "which" -> Result(if (args.firstOrNull() in COMMANDS) 0 else 1, if (args.firstOrNull() in COMMANDS) "/bin/${args.first()}\n" else "")
206:             "true" -> Result(0, "")
207:             "false" -> Result(1, "")

213:     private fun flagsFree(args: List<String>): List<String> = args.filter { !it.startsWith("-") }
214: 
215:     private fun ls(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
216:         val all = args.any { it == "-a" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" }
217:         val long = args.any { it == "-l" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" || it == "-lh" }
218:         val targets = flagsFree(args).ifEmpty { listOf(".") }
219:         val out = StringBuilder()
220:         var exit = 0
221:         for (t in targets) {

223:             if (f == null || !f.exists()) { exit = 1; out.append("ls: $t: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
224:             val entries = when {
225:                 f.isDirectory -> f.listFiles()?.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() } ?: emptyList()
226:                 else -> listOf(f)
227:             }.filter { all || !it.name.startsWith(".") }
228:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("${t}:\n")
229:             for (e in entries) {
230:                 if (long) {
231:                     out.append("%s %8d  %s\n".format(if (e.isDirectory()) "d" else "-", e.length(), e.name))
232:                 } else {
233:                     out.append(if (e.isDirectory()) e.name + "/" else e.name)
234:                     out.append("\n")
235:                 }
236:             }
237:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("\n")
238:         }
239:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
240:     }

242:     private fun cat(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
243:         if (args.isEmpty() || args.first() == "-") return Result(0, stdin)
244:         val out = StringBuilder()
245:         var exit = 0
246:         for (a in args) {
247:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
248:             if (f == null || !f.isFile) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
249:             if (f.length() > MAX_FILE) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: файл слишком большой\n"); continue }
250:             out.append(f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
251:         }
252:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
253:     }
254: 
255:     private fun mkdir(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
256:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-p" }
257:         var exit = 0
258:         val out = StringBuilder()
259:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {
260:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
261:             if (f == null) { exit = 1; continue }
262:             if (f.exists()) {
263:                 if (!recursive) { exit = 1; out.append("mkdir: $a: уже существует\n") }

272:     private fun rm(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
273:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-r" || it == "-rf" || it == "-fr" || it == "-R" }
274:         var exit = 0
275:         val out = StringBuilder()
276:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {
277:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)

280:             if (!f.deleteRecursively()) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: не удалось удалить\n") }
281:         }
282:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
283:     }

285:     private fun mv(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {

288:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
289:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
290:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "mv: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
291:         val target = if (to.isDirectory) File(to, from.name) else to
292:         target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
293:         return if (from.renameTo(target)) Result(0, "") else Result(1, "mv: не удалось переместить\n")
294:     }

296:     private fun cp(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
297:         val files = flagsFree(args)

299:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
300:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
301:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "cp: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")

566:     /** Shell tokenizer: single/double quotes keep groups together. */
567:     internal fun tokenize(line: String): List<String> {
568:         val out = mutableListOf<String>()
569:         val cur = StringBuilder()
570:         var quote: Char? = null
571:         var has = false
572:         var i = 0
573:         while (i < line.length) {
574:             val c = line[i]
575:             when {
576:                 quote != null -> {
577:                     if (c == quote) quote = null else cur.append(c)
578:                 }
579:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; has = true }
580:                 c.isWhitespace() -> {
581:                     if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) { out += cur.toString(); cur.clear(); has = false }
582:                 }
583:                 else -> cur.append(c)
584:             }
585:             i++
586:         }
587:         if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) out += cur.toString()
588:         return out
589:     }

591:     /** Glob match with `*`, `?` and `**` support. */
592:     internal fun globMatch(pattern: String, path: String): Boolean {
593:         val regex = buildString {
594:             append('^')
595:             var i = 0
596:             while (i < pattern.length) {
597:                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
598:                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
599:                     '?' -> append('.')
600:                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
601:                 }
602:                 i++
603:             }
604:             append('$')
605:         }
606:         return Regex(regex).matches(path)
607:     }

parts.text:
I notice a bug at line 141: `"npm" -> npm(args, dir, timeoutMs)` is misindented (cosmetic).

Now let me check the gradle test run progress and read Sessions.kt + Exec.kt for timeout structure.

Let me also plan the concrete changes. Let me create a todo list.

Key issues to fix (mapping to user complaints):

A. "раундов слишком мало" (too few rounds)
1. `AgentSettings.DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 12` → 40; `MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 60` → 500. UI: allow 3 digits.
2. When the budget is exhausted: currently the turn just fails with a message, and the *history is saved* (good) but the assistant's last tool calls are left unanswered?? Let's check: after the loop, if the model returned tool calls and we exit the loop due to step budget, the last assistant message with tool_calls IS in `full`, and all tool results were appended (since we execute calls within the step). So history is consistent. Good. But the message says "достигнут лимит шагов ... уточните запрос" — better: tell the user to say "продолжай", and count rounds as tool calls rather than LLM rounds.

Actually wait, there's a real bug: `Event.Failed` for the step limit is shown as an error, and retryLast is offered. Fine-ish. But better UX: on budget exhaustion, if the model was making progress, we can automatically continue with a synthesized user message ("Continue...") up to a hard cap. Hmm, risky. I'll instead:
- Raise limits.
- Add an explicit "продолжай" convenience: the retry button. Eh.

Let me think about what actually is a "недоработка" here and valuable: when the model hits the step budget, we could automatically send a follow-up user message "Продолжай с того места, где остановился" and continue, but this doubles the wall time. Given the user complains "раундов слишком мало", raising the cap is the direct fix. I'll also make the limit apply to LLM rounds and show a clear message with the count of completed tool calls.

B. "иногда время истекает на запрос 900 с когда аи очень многое делает особенно генерация и ожидание чего либо"
Root cause: long single HTTP request to the LLM endpoint (non-streaming) — read timeout 300 s, plus gateways with idle timeouts. Fix:
1. Implement SSE streaming in LlmClient with delta aggregation, and a fallback to non-streaming if the server doesn't stream. Streaming keeps the connection alive and also allows UI "thinking" feedback.
2. Increase readTimeout and add a per-attempt retry with exponential backoff for transient failures (timeouts, 429, 5xx), and surface a clear Russian error message ("превышено время ожидания модели").
3. Add cancellation support: pass a `shouldCancel` check so a stop button interrupts a hung request. Currently cancelling during an LLM call does nothing until the call returns (could be 300 s). With streaming we can check between chunks → cancel works. That's a real bug fix.

C. "потом пуш и комит и сборка там же" (then push and commit and build there)
- GitHub: multi-file atomic commit via the git data API (`push` op with `files` → single commit), plus `run_wait` (block until a run completes, with a timeout) so the agent doesn't burn rounds polling, and `jobs`? Maybe `run_status` with wait. Also `push` currently does one commit per file (slow, and for >20 files rate limits). Implement `push_commit` semantics inside the existing `push` op: use git data API when files > 1 (or always, with a fallback to contents API). Also handle 409 conflicts on contents API.
- Also add a `sleep`-like wait? MiniShell has sleep max 30 s.

D. Other bugs/недоработки I can spot:
1. `LlmClient.models()` doesn't disconnect connections (minor leak) — same for chat and GitHubClient.call. On Android, HttpURLConnection keep-alive can hold sockets; not a big deal but let's disconnect properly.
2. `LlmClient.chat` doesn't set `Accept: application/json`; doesn't handle empty choices array (IndexOutOfBounds → generic message). Add a friendly error when the response shape is unexpected.
3. `LlmClient.chat` doesn't support `max_tokens`. Not needed.
4. The `Event.Question` and `Event.Todos` events are never emitted by the agent (dead code) — the VM handles them but nothing sends them. Minor; the UI shows "агент ждёт ответа на вопрос…" — wait, `_pendingQuestion` state drives QuestionCard; the Info event never fires, fine.
5. In AppViewModel.runAgentTurn, `_agentSteps` counts tool calls, and the final info says "раундов: N". Also if the turn ends with an error, `_agentRunning` is set false — ok. But if the agent throws (exception in the executor runnable), `_agentRunning` stays true forever → UI stuck with "агент работает…" and no stop. That's a real bug: wrap the executor body in try/finally. Also `agentCancelled` is read once at start (`agent.cancelled = agentCancelled.get()`) — a snapshot! `OpenCodeAgent.cancelled` is a plain var copied once, so the stop button does NOT stop the loop. Real bug: need to pass a lambda `isCancelled: () -> Boolean`. That's important: "Остановка: ⏹ — ход прерывается" doesn't work. Let me verify: `agent.cancelled = agentCancelled.get()` — yes, snapshot. The agent's loop checks `if (cancelled)` which is a snapshot value false forever. So stop only works for pending question/approval latches. Definite bug to fix.
6. `Sessions.save` etc. — let me read Sessions.kt.
7. In `runAgentTurn`, when the user cancels, the code still persists and adds "⏱ раундов..." info. Fine.
8. `AppViewModel.attachFile` — `runCatching { resolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {...} }` fine.
9. History growth: no context trimming. With 500 rounds, the message array will explode (each tool result up to 16 KB) → request bodies become huge, slow, and will hit context limits/timeouts. THIS is likely the real reason for timeouts! With MAX_READ 32 KB and MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT 16 KB per call, 40 rounds → 640 KB of history. Many providers cap at 128k tokens; Zen free models are small (e.g. 32k context). So long turns fail. A real недоработка: add history compaction — when the history grows beyond a threshold, summarize/trim old tool outputs (keep first/last N chars) and drop stale tool results. This is a genuinely valuable fix for "время истекает" and "раундов мало".

So: implement a `HistoryCompactor` in the agent: before each request, if the estimated size of the non-system messages exceeds a limit (e.g. 60 KB), trim the oldest tool messages (replace their content with a placeholder "… (сокращено)"), keeping the most recent N exchanges intact. Must keep the tool-call/tool-result pairing valid for OpenAI APIs: if we drop an assistant message with tool_calls, we must drop the corresponding tool messages; if we keep the assistant message with tool_calls we must keep its tool results. So the compactor should operate on "exchange groups": each assistant message with tool_calls plus its following tool messages = one group. Drop whole groups from the oldest end, but keep the first user message (the original request) for context, and never drop a group partially — instead shorten tool content within a group when we need to keep it.

Implementation plan for compactor:
- Build groups: [user?] + pairs.
- If over budget: for each group from oldest, replace tool result contents with a truncated version ("… (N симв. сокращено)") until under budget; then drop whole groups (except the initial user message) from the oldest end until under budget.
- Also cap single tool outputs: MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT 16 KB is fine but for history we can cap at e.g. 4 KB with head+tail.

That's a solid improvement and testable in a JVM unit test (pure JSON logic). 

10. `webfetch` on large pages — fine.
11. MiniShell `sleep` max 30 s — the agent can't wait. With `run_wait` in GitHub this is less needed. Maybe raise to 300 s? "ожидание чего либо" — waiting. I'll raise the sleep cap to 300 s and make the tool description mention it. Hmm, blocking the agent thread for 5 min is not great but the agent has nothing else to do anyway. Let me instead cap at 120 s and mention it.

12. BASH_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000 — for builds (npm install) that's often too short; "сборка" (build) — the user mentions build in the runner (GitHub). But local `npm install` of a big package can exceed 120 s. Raise to 600 s? That would make a hung command block for 10 min. I'd raise to 300 s (5 min) with a `timeout` arg up to that.

13. `Event.ToolDone` matching in the VM: `items.indexOfLast { it is Tool && it.result == null && it.name == event.name }` — with parallel/sequential same-name calls it's fine since sequential.

14. `historyToItems` on resume: tool results are not restored (Tool rows show empty results) — cosmetic.

Now the HistoryTrimmer. Let me write it as a new file in the opencode package.

Design:

```kotlin
package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

/**
 * Keeps the request small enough for the model to answer...
 */
object HistoryTrimmer {
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 96_000
    const val TOOL_KEEP = 3_000

    fun trim(messages: JSONArray, maxChars: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS, toolKeep: Int = TOOL_KEEP): JSONArray
}
```

Algorithm:
1. `if (messages.length() <= 2) return messages`
2. blocks: iterate from index 1 (after the system message), grouping:


input.newString:
"file_get" -> gh.fileGet(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("path"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                "file_delete" -> {
                    val arr = args.optJSONArray("paths")
                        ?: return "error: нужен массив paths[]"
                    val paths = (0 until arr.length()).mapNotNull { arr.optString(it).takeIf { p -> p.isNotEmpty() } }
                    if (paths.isEmpty()) return "error: paths пуст"
                    gh.deleteFiles(
                        args.getString("repo"), paths,
                        args.optString("message", "remove files"),
                        args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                    )
                }
                "workflow_create" -> gh.workflowCreate(args.getString("repo"), args.optString("filename", "run.yml"), args.getString("yaml"))
                "dispatch" -> gh.dispatch(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("workflow"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
                "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
                    repo = args.getString("repo"),
                    runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
                    timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),

Now the AppViewModel. Changes:
1. `try/finally` around the turn body.
2. Pass `isCancelled = { agentCancelled.get() }`, set `tools.cancelCheck`.
3. New events: Round, Thinking, Note; remove Question/Todos handling.
4. Add `_modelPreview` StateFlow.
5. Add `/continue` command.
6. Track round count for the final message.

Let me write the new `runAgentTurn` and related pieces.

```kotlin
    private fun runAgentTurn(userText: String) {
        val config = _llmConfig.value
        if (!config.isReady) return
        _agentRunning.value = true
        agentCancelled.set(false)
        _agentSteps.value = 0
        _agentRounds.value = 0
        _modelPreview.value = ""
        _turnStartedAt.value = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val turnStart = _turnStartedAt.value

        agentExecutor.execute {
            try {
                ... existing body ...
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                _agentMessages.update { it + AgentItem.Error(t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName) }
            } finally {
                _modelPreview.value = ""
                _agentRunning.value = false
            }
        }
    }
```

And the final Info message: "⏱ раундов: rounds · инструментов: steps · время: secs · сессия сохранена".

Where rounds = `_agentRounds`, steps = `_agentSteps`.

Note the existing condition `if (_agentSteps.value > 0 || agentCancelled.get())`. Let me also show it when rounds > 0 (always, basically). Use `if (_agentRounds.value > 0 || agentCancelled.get())`.

For the events:
```kotlin
                    is OpenCodeAgent.Event.Round -> _agentRounds.value = event.step
                    is OpenCodeAgent.Event.Thinking -> _modelPreview.value = event.preview
                    is OpenCodeAgent.Event.Note -> _agentMessages.update { it + AgentItem.Info(event.text) }
```

Also: `agent.cancelled = agentCancelled.get()` → remove; the agent now takes the lambda.

Also `tools.cancelCheck = { agentCancelled.get() }`.

`/continue` command: in sendToAgent's `when`:
```kotlin
            "/continue" -> {
                if (!requireConfigured()) return
                _agentMessages.update { it + AgentItem.User("/continue") }
                runAgentTurn(OpenCodeAgent.CONTINUE_PROMPT)
                return
            }
```
Hmm, if there's no session/history, `/continue` on an empty session would just be a prompt. Fine.

Also, `retryLast`: currently re-sends the same prompt. Keep, but the message says "(повтор)". Let me improve: if the last error was about the round limit, offer /continue. Simple approach: `retryLast` sends `lastPrompt`; the AgentScreen shows the button "↻ Повторить последний запрос" when the last item is an Error. Let me add a second button for the limit case? Simpler: in the VM, when the round limit is hit, `lastPrompt` is irrelevant. Let me just add both buttons in the UI: "↻ Повторить" and "→ Продолжить (/continue)" when the last message is an Error. That's a clean UX improvement. I'll add a `continueLast()` function that sends CONTINUE_PROMPT if the current session has messages.

Now, the tests. Let me write:
1. `LlmClientTest` — SSE stream aggregation (text deltas, tool calls split across chunks, reasoning fallback, error event, [DONE], non-JSON → UnusableAnswer), plus `describe`/`isRetryable`? `UnusableAnswer` is private... `LlmException` is public. Testing `Stream` (internal) and `parseMessage` (internal) is enough.
2. `HistoryTrimmerTest` — grouping validity (no orphan tool messages), the system message preserved, shrinking, dropping.
3. Update `OpenCodeToolsGateTest` — READ_OPS assertions: add run_wait as read-only, run_cancel as mutating, file_delete as mutating.
4. `AgentSettingsTest` — DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS 40, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT 500 (the existing test uses the constants, so it still passes). Let me add an assertion that the default is a sane value ≥ 20 and the limit is ≥ 100 so a regression to 12/60 gets caught.
5. Maybe a test for the agent loop itself with a fake LLM client! `clientFactory` returns `LlmClient` (a concrete class), so I can't fake it without a server... I could spin up a tiny HTTP server in the test with `com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer` (available on the JVM). That would test streaming end-to-end: SSE responses, tool calls, round limits, cancellation. That's a strong test. Is HttpServer available in the Android unit-test JVM? Yes, it's JDK (com.sun.net.httpserver), and unit tests run on the desktop JVM. 

That would be a great verification of the whole loop: the agent with a fake OpenAI-compatible server. Let me write `OpenCodeAgentTest`:
- Start an HttpServer on a random port that responds to POST /chat/completions with a scripted sequence: first a tool call (bash echo), then a text answer.
- Build Workspace in a temp folder, JsRuntime with boot.js, NpxRuntime, OpenCodeTools, and the agent with clientFactory = { LlmClient(AgentSettings.Config("http://localhost:port/v1", "", "test-model")) }.
- Assert: the tools ran, the history ends with an assistant message, the events order, the rounds.

Also test the step limit: a server that always returns a tool call → the loop should stop at maxSteps with the "достигнут лимит раундов" message.

And cancellation: isCancelled returns true after N calls → the loop ends with the cancelled message and the tool results are balanced (every tool_call_id has a tool message). That's a valuable regression test for the bug I fixed.

This is a good investment. Let me write it. boot.js path: the test needs `src/main/assets/node/boot.js` relative to the android dir (working directory for unit tests is the module dir `android/app`? In AGP, the unit test working directory is the project dir (android/app) by default... The existing tests try `src/main/assets/node/boot.js` and `app/src/main/assets/node/boot.js`, so cwd is `android/`. I'll reuse the same helper logic.

Actually, for the agent test I don't even need a real bash tool: I can use a tool that doesn't need the shell... but OpenCodeTools requires jsRuntime/npxRuntime in the constructor. I can construct them with boot.js like the other tests do (OpenCodeToolsGateTest does exactly that). Fine — reuse the pattern.

```kotlin
    private fun startServer(responses: List<String>): Pair<Int, () -> Unit> {
```
